title: Resolve blockers and dependencies
description: Use when LPM activities are blocked (bloqueada) or depend on other work: find blockers, record or resolve a blocker reason, add or remove dependency links (any project or workspace), read the dependency graph/critical path. Not for roadmap-item dependencies (use lpm-roadmap-owner-ops).
doneWhen: Each blocked activity has its cause recorded as a link, a blocker context or a decision request, and a re-read shows it.
authorityCeiling: Links and contexts are [A]; link deletes and cross-workspace links are [C]; scope stays with the owner (GOV-MAX v1).
